plan.hypothesis: Fixed40ms output-supervision delay supplies additional already-arrived acoustic evidence for short unit assignments, without input lookahead, changing encoder or relaxing exact sequence matching.
plan.sampling: One independently sampled full six-class matched cell per each of four carriers; fixed resumable sampler seeds.
plan.objective: 0.5 recording-normalized frame CE + 0.5 equal-position CE; no background objective.
plan.checkpoint_policy: Save latest every 250 steps and final at 5000; no checkpoint selection on validation. Final checkpoint only for subsequent diagnostic replay.
plan.event_policy: Existing exact ordered unit event policy; confidence code 128, span 200 frames, refractory 200 frames. Fixed diagnostic only, no qualified threshold.
plan.resources: RTX4090 required; CPU numerical threads1. Read existing PCM, no new waveform/features cache, disk reserve100GiB. Keep initial/latest/final checkpoints only.
plan.acceptance: Training diagnostic only. No replacement of frozen v30. Trained full-wave float behavior, actual-state INT8 calibration/export, fresh development and sealed acceptance including FAR upper95<=0.5/h remain required.
plan.stop_conditions: Nonfinite loss/gradient, unavailable CUDA, insufficient disk reserve, or failed source hashes: stop and retain failure. Do not silently retry with changed hyperparameters.
plan.control: position-supervised-v1, identical initial weights and5000step descriptors; only output labels delayed4frames.
plan.diagnostic: Both final checkpoints on all4320training recordings using unchanged raw argmax exact matcher and chunk37 parity; retain prior control census. Event timestamp stays actual frame end, never subtract40ms to improve latency. No threshold search/heldout use.
